Class OpenDialog<V>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.testing.OpenDialog<V>
Type Parameters:
V - the dialog view class
public final class OpenDialog<V> extends Object
A dialog view the tester shows, as an answer registered with FakeDialogs.answerDialog(Class, Consumer) sees it. Its methods are called on the EDT.
